name: Lakeview Dental Clinic
address: 1200 Market Street, Suite 210 (free parking behind the building, wheelchair access)
hours_text: Monday to Friday 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM (closed 1 to 2 PM for lunch), Saturday 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM, Sunday closed

services.name: Check-up & cleaning
services.price: from $85; new patients $99 for exam, X-rays and cleaning

services.name: Tooth pain / emergency
services.price: $79 emergency exam; same-day slots kept free

dentists: Dr. Emily Carter: general and cosmetic dentistry, whitening
Dr. James Patel: implants, crowns and root canals
insurance: Most PPO plans, including Delta Dental, Cigna, Aetna, MetLife and Guardian. Not accepted: HMO plans and Medicaid. No insurance: 0% payment plans over 12 months for treatment above $500.
policies: Please give 24 hours' notice to cancel or move a visit.
Arrive 10 minutes early and bring a photo ID and your insurance card.
emergency_rule: Severe facial swelling, trouble breathing or swallowing, heavy bleeding that will not stop, or a jaw injury: tell the caller to call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room now. Toothache, a broken tooth or a lost filling: offer the earliest emergency slot.
